evidence.source_statement: For each necessary unsafe Rust operation or C FFI boundary in an authorized C-to-Rust port, prefer safe Rust where feasible, isolate the boundary, document required safety and ABI invariants, and test the exposed contract.
source_conditions: An authorized C-to-Rust port uses Rust unsafe operations or an FFI boundary.
source_exceptions: No unsafe or FFI boundary is required when a fully safe Rust implementation can express the behavior.

interpretation.situation_scope: Relationships describe relevant contexts, not exhaustive triggers or narrower rule applicability.
interpretation.intent_semantics: Intent relationships describe inferred underlying outcomes; normative authority remains with the original rule.
interpretation.effective_rules: No rule, rule profile, or execution instruction is altered by linking.
